  - text: CLASS 12 • THREE-DIMENSIONAL GEOMETRY
  - heading "Vector Equation of a Line" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Explore the line determined by an anchor point a and direction vector b using r = a + λb.
  - text: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT geometry2d
  - main:
    - text: INTERACTIVE EXPLORER
    - heading "Anchor + Direction 3D Explorer" [level=2]
    - button "Reset":
      - img

      - text: Animate

      - img
      - text: Help

      - text: λ = 2
      - article:
        - heading "Anchor vector a" [level=3]
        - text: a = (1, -1, 2) x
        - spinbutton "a x": "1"
        - text: "y"
        - spinbutton "a y": "-1"
        - text: z
        - spinbutton "a z": "2"
      - article:
        - heading "Direction vector b" [level=3]

        - text: z
        - spinbutton "b z": "3"

        - heading "Parameter λ" [level=3]

        - strong: P(2) = (5, 1, 8)

    - article:
      - img "Interactive anchor direction vector line scene": x y z A = a (1, -1, 2) b (2, 1, 3) P(2) = (5, 1, 8)
      - text: ━ a = (1,-1,2) ━ b = (2,1,3) ┄ Line r=a+λb
    - complementary:
      - article:
        - heading "Current values" [level=3]
        - paragraph: a = (1,-1,2)
        - paragraph: "|a| = 2.449"
        - paragraph: b = (2,1,3)
        - paragraph: "|b| = 3.742"
        - paragraph: a · b = 7
        - paragraph: Angle(a,b) = 40.203°
        - paragraph: λ = 2
        - paragraph: P(2) = (5,1,8)
      - article:
        - heading "Vector equation" [level=3]
        - paragraph: r = a + λb
        - paragraph: = (1,-1,2) + λ(2,1,3)
      - article:
        - heading "Coordinate (symmetric) form" [level=3]
        - paragraph: (x−1)/2 = (y−(-1))/1 = (z−2)/3
      - article:
        - heading "Parametric form" [level=3]
        - paragraph: x = 1 + 2λ y = -1 + 1λ z = 2 + 3λ
    - article:
      - heading "Vector addition (parallelogram rule)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: P = a + λb is the diagonal formed by a and λb.
      - img: P(λ)
    - article:
      - heading "Positive and negative λ" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The line extends infinitely in both directions.
      - button "λ=-2"
      - button "λ=0"
      - button "λ=2"
      - paragraph: λ=-2 P=(-3,-3,-4)
      - paragraph: λ=2 P=(5,1,8)
    - article:
      - heading "Position vector vs direction vector" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Position vector Gives location of a point and starts at the origin.
      - paragraph: Direction vector Gives direction, not position. Parallel multiples define the same line.
    - article:
      - heading "Point-on-line test" [level=3]
      - paragraph: "Q=(5,1,8): Q−a=(4,2,6)=2b, so λ=2."
      - strong:
        - img
        - text: Yes, Q lies on the line at λ=2.
    - heading "Worked example" [level=3]
    - article:
      - paragraph: "For A(1,-1,2), b=(2,1,3):"
      - text: r=(1,-1,2)+λ(2,1,3)
    - article:
      - text: Parametric equations
      - paragraph: x=1+2λ y=-1+λ z=2+3λ
    - article:
      - text: Find points on the line
      - paragraph: P(0)=(1,-1,2) P(1)=(3,0,5) P(2)=(5,1,8)
